root_cause_summary: The Docker nginx container was serving a stale frontend dist bundle built before the Breadcrumb component was fixed. The old Breadcrumb called useMatches() from react-router v7, which requires DataRouterStateContext (only available via createBrowserRouter + RouterProvider). The app uses BrowserRouter which does not provide this context. The fix was already in source (Breadcrumb uses useLocation); the container was rebuilt to serve the correct bundle. The only source change in this issue is updating a stale test comment in AdminLayout.test.tsx.
